caption: The drawing features a woman standing and facing forward who is dressed in a floor-length green gown with wide sleeves and a fitted bodice. The coat-like outer garment has a plaid pattern in red, blue, yellow, and white along the inner front trimmed edges and the sleeve cuffs, as well as at the peplum flaps at the waist. The woman’s hands are visible, and she has light skin and dark, center-parted hair styled smoothly and tucked behind her ears, with a hair accessory at the top of her head. The dress beneath the coat appears to be off-white or beige and is only partially visible. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, lightly sketched outline of the same figure from the back, without color detail, showing the rear view of the dress, hairstyle, and peplum shape. The background is plain, and the paper color is a light, yellowish beige.
title: Doll
